BiblicalUsage: Jeribai is an Israelite, a son of Elnaam, one of David's mighty men. In 1 Chronicles 11:46, Jeribai, and Joshaviah.
TheologicalSignificance: What grips me is that Jeribai is named at all, which tells me God sees individuals, not only crowds.
